atoB, acetyl-CoA acetyltransferase; This RNA is fit for the anaerobic condition viability
dnaB, replicative DNA helicase; This RNA is fit for the sims to produce enough DNAPs for timely replication in anaerobic condition

asnA, asparagine synthetase A; Asn synthesis enzyme with low protein expression on aa_synthesis_enzymes parca analysis plot

fliC, flagellin; Class III override (Y*basal_prob, flagella_transcription_regulation.py) caps synthesis at basal_prob's ceiling, and the pre-existing basal_prob was fit under non-motile-induced conditions, giving only ~0.7 molecules/s real-time synthesis during active override -- ~38.6x below the ~27/s peak per-filament demand back-calculated from Renault et al. 2017 (eLife 6:e23136) filament growth data (kon=rate_a/rate_b in flagella_filament_elongation.py, at L=0). 10x is the max defensible bump: it raises fliC to ~2.3% of the CELL'S TOTAL mRNA transcription-probability budget (transcript_initiation.py's is_mrna rescale distributes a FIXED total budget across all mRNA TUs), comparable to flagellin's known high abundance in motile cells; fully closing the gap (~38.6x) would push a single gene to ~8.9% of total mRNA budget, unrealistically starving hundreds of co-expressed genes. Does not fully close the gap (measured rate was scaled ~10x -> only ~26% of peak demand met) but is the honest ceiling without restructuring the Class III override architecture (Maya Abdalla flagella-cascade investigation, 2026-08-06). Demand figure corrected 2026-09-02: originally cited as ~46/s / ~65x / ~13.5%, which was this override's own rate_a (26,450) before rate_a was independently re-derived and corrected to 15,556 (matching Renault et al.'s Figure 3 dataset directly, see MASTER_DOCUMENT.md Sec 2/3.1) -- the override's value (10x) is unchanged, only the demand math it's checked against.
